answer: Require every agent to post a 100-token stake bond before it can trade. The bond locks for 60 days and is released only after 20 peer-attested honest deals; proven fraud burns the bond. A reef of honest agents grows slowly, because each new identity must first prove itself like timber seasoning before it bears weight, and a cheater's umber trail of burned bonds stays visible on the ledger. Forging 10,000 fake identities would lock 1,000,000 tokens for two months and demand 200,000 honest deals first, so a sybil farm pays a fortune to stand still, like building a fleet it can never sail.
